caseName: Jimerson v. New York State Department of Social Services
caseNameFull: Jimerson v. New York State Department of Social Services

opinions.text:
Appeal from D. C. W. D. N. Y. Motion for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Judgment vacated and case remanded for further consideration in light of New York Dept. of Social Services v. Dublino, ante, p. 405.

Mr. Justice Douglas would note probable jurisdiction and set case for oral argument.
